findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_zone_tendue, calculate_tenant_notice_period, calculate_home_employment_end_of_contract · Private data: calculate_home_employment_end_of_contract, calculate_assistant_maternel_end_of_contract, generate_rent_receipt · Public sink: calculate_deposit_restitution, calculate_teletravail_frontalier, check_geneva_quasi_resident.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_zone_tendue, calculate_tenant_notice_period, calculate_home_employment_end_of_contract · Private data: calculate_home_employment_end_of_contract, calculate_assistant_maternel_end_of_contract, generate_rent_receipt · Public sink: calculate_deposit_restitution, calculate_teletravail_frontalier, check_geneva_quasi_resident

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
